title: Welcome to Mimikit
intro: Point it at a folder of game assets and it indexes every sprite, sound, model, font and video in it, then keeps watching for changes.
readOnly: You can add more folders later. Mimikit only reads them: your files are never changed.

drag.title: Drag into your engine
drag.body: Drop any card into Unity's Project window, Godot or a folder to copy the file there.

preview.title: Preview in place
preview.body: Select an asset and press {{peekKey}} to look, Enter for full screen.

search.title: Find anything
search.body: Search names, {{tagExample}}, {{typeExample}} or folders from anywhere.
